spec_match.rationale: Each card is one of the explainer's stated guarantees (read-only state, no page trigger, untrusted forgeries, quiet-by-default anti-fingerprinting) executed as a real check, with the privacy section linked.

interactive.rationale: Three try-it buttons run real assignments, dispatches, and prototype enumeration; the fourth card is a live counter wired to trusted events only.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises live proof of the cannot-do list; delivered per card.

edge_cases.rationale: Each check handles the trial-off context with an explicitly labelled degraded result (e.g. nothing to assign) instead of a fake pass; the enumeration would also catch an unexpected trigger method appearing.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5076374013476864; the page links the explainer's privacy section directly.

conformance.rationale: Cards 1–3 are the same contracts as the suite's readonly/no-trigger/untrusted assertions; card 4 matches the manual user-intent assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: all three buttons produced the correct honest results (not-exposed note, isTrusted false, no members) and the quiet counter stayed at 0; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: One assert per contract records the observed outcome, including the quiet baseline.

design_system.rationale: Result chips use emerald/amber on stone (AA); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Each result chip is a role=status aria-live region tied to its button; headings number the contracts; controls are native buttons.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Cards are full-width with wrapping rows and min-width:0; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Re-run contracts 1 and 3 behind the flag
openQuestions.detail: With UAImageReplacementAPI exposed, card 1 should show the assignment silently ignored with the value still false, and card 3 should enumerate exactly the three observation members with no function among them.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair each action with its own announced result region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every contract card has its own role=status chip updated by its button.

guidanceConsulted.query: stacked contract cards wrapping results mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let result chips wrap with overflow-wrap for long text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Rows are flex-wrap and chips use overflow-wrap:anywhere; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): all four contract checks return the honest expected results on Chromium 141 (trial off), with clean console at both viewports. Behind-the-flag re-runs are recorded as a minor open question.
